text:
maria_csm: Hey team, kicking off Sundial Health onboarding. TL;DR: they9re deploying Redwood Private into their AWS VPC for PHI workloads. Goal: go-live in ~8 weeks. Need to align on owners, success criteria, timeline, and immediate blockers. Customer contacts: Priya (Sundial PM), Dan (Sundial Sec). Internal owners I9m proposing: Maria (CSM), Alex (SE), Joanne (Platform Eng), Ken (Ops), Sam (Enablement), Ruth (Program). Call out if I missed someone.

maria_csm: Proposed success criteria:
- Private endpoints & VPC peering validated and documented
- SAML SSO + user provisioning tested end-to-end
- PHI field mapping validated; signed proof-of-execution (POE) for ingestion
- Demo flows show p50 latency <250ms for 95% of requests
- Training delivered; runbook + oncall contacts handed off to Sundial

maria_csm: High-level timeline suggestion:
W0 (this week): kickoff, collect SAML metadata, sample payloads
W1-2: infra prep (VPC, SGs, certs, KMS) + baseline network tests
W3-4: integration (API keys, model mapping, sample data validation)
W5: pilot (canary traffic window)
W6-7: iterate, finalize runbooks & docs
W8: go-live + 30d health check

maria_csm: Primary risks: SAML metadata delay, unclear PHI schema mapping, cert/KMS provisioning lag, outstanding legal/compliance docs.

alex_se: I9ll own SE work: model mapping, API contract, test harness. I need sample payloads + SAML metadata from Priya. I9ll put an integration checklist together by EOW. :+1:

sam_cs: I9m on enablement: two 90m sessions (devs + ops), quickstart doc, recording. I9ll also set up success metrics dashboard (uptime, p50/p95, error rate).

joanne_eng: I9ll validate VPC connectivity and run network checklist. Quick question: expected peak RPS for pilot and go-live? That affects batching/pool config.

ken_ops: I9ll handle cert provisioning & KMS access. If Sundial supplies their KMS ARN, certs usually take 3-5 business days. HSM/KMS integrations add ~1 week. Need copy of any SOC2/BAA asks.

ruth_pm: I9ll run the rollout timeline + canary plan. Proposal: start 10% traffic for 72h, fallback to hosted model if errors >2% or latency >1s.

maria_csm: @joanne_eng they9re estimating modest initial load 150 RPS peak for pilot, 200 RPS steady. I9ll confirm with Priya and update.

alex_se: That9s reasonable. We should plan autoscale buffer and a KV cache warmup (pre-populate top prefixes).

joanne_eng: will draft autoscale policy and add to network checklist.

ken_ops: flags: cert timings + KMS could slip timeline if customer manages keys. Also ask legal for any addenda they require.

maria_csm: Actions from this thread:
- Maria: confirm RPS + request SAML metadata & sample payloads (by Tue)
- Alex: integration checklist draft (EOW)
- Joanne: network checklist + autoscale draft (mid next week)
- Ken: cert/KMS runbook + compliance doc list (by Wed)
- Sam: enablement plan + training dates (next Thu/Fri)
- Ruth: canary config + rollback playbook (next Wed)

maria_csm: @onboardbot please schedule a 60m kickoff with Sundial and internal owners Tue 11am PT and add calendar link to thread.

onboardbot: Meeting scheduled: Tue 11:00 AM PT 1 60m 1 "Sundial Health: Redwood Onboarding Kickoff" Join: https://meet.example.com/abcd1234 (invites sent).

alex_se: :thumbsup: I9ll block time.

sam_cs: +1 1 will prep agenda and training slides.

ruth_pm: I9ll create a shared project board and add these action items.

maria_csm: thanks everyone. I9ll post updates here as we get artifacts from Sundial. If anything changes the timeline, flag it here or DM me. :rocket:
